tickets.title: Approval lembur Arunika langsung ke HR tanpa supervisor
tickets.reason: Supervisor toko Arunika sering cuti, sehingga pengajuan lembur tertahan 3 sampai 5 hari.

comments.text: Dikonfirmasi dengan Pak Budi lewat telepon; berlaku untuk semua cabang Arunika.

decision.what_changed: Pengajuan lembur karyawan toko Arunika langsung disetujui oleh HR Manager; langkah persetujuan supervisor dilewati.
decision.why: Persetujuan tertahan berhari-hari saat supervisor cuti, dan lembur terlambat dibayar.
decision.alternatives: Supervisor cadangan ditolak karena setiap toko Arunika hanya punya satu supervisor.

tickets.title: Two-level overtime approval for Bumi Logistik
tickets.reason: Driver overtime at Bumi Logistik ran 30% over budget in Q1 2025, and operations wants to check each request.

decision.what_changed: Overtime requests at Bumi Logistik need two approvals: the operations manager first, then HR.
decision.why: Bumi's operations director wants to control driver overtime costs before HR approves pay.
decision.alternatives: A monthly overtime budget cap was rejected because trips cannot be planned that far ahead.

tickets.title: Block overtime above 18 hours per week
tickets.reason: PP 35/2021 limits overtime to 4 hours a day and 18 hours a week; two clients were fined in audits.

decision.what_changed: Overtime requests are blocked when they would take an employee past 4 hours in a day or 18 hours in a week.
decision.why: Government Regulation PP 35/2021 sets these limits and labor audits check them.
decision.alternatives: A warning without blocking was rejected because HR approved over-limit requests anyway.

tickets.title: Auto-approve overtime under 2 hours for Arunika
tickets.reason: Arunika store staff often work 30 to 90 minutes past closing and Budi wants less clicking.

decision.what_changed: Not implemented: overtime is never approved automatically, not even under 2 hours.
decision.why: Every overtime payment needs a named human approver for labor audits and payroll disputes.
decision.alternatives: A bulk approval screen for HR was offered instead (see the follow-up ticket).

tickets.title: Bulk approve overtime requests
tickets.reason: HR at Arunika approves over 200 short overtime requests after each weekend.

decision.what_changed: HR can select up to 50 pending overtime requests and approve them in one action; each request still records the approver.
decision.why: It keeps a human approver for audits while cutting HR's weekend backlog from hours to minutes.

tickets.title: Nomor batch produksi wajib diisi saat pengajuan lembur Cahaya
tickets.reason: Audit CPOB (GMP) meminta setiap jam lembur di pabrik Cahaya bisa dilacak ke batch produksi.

decision.what_changed: Pengajuan lembur karyawan Cahaya Farma wajib menyertakan nomor batch produksi.
decision.why: Auditor CPOB harus bisa menelusuri jam lembur ke batch obat yang diproduksi.
decision.alternatives: Kode proyek bebas ditolak karena tidak bisa dicocokkan dengan catatan batch.

tickets.title: Compute driver overtime from GPS trip logs
tickets.reason: Drivers forget to submit overtime and disputes take weeks.

tickets.title: Geofence clock-in radius 100 m for Arunika stores
tickets.reason: Some Arunika staff clocked in from home before reaching the store.

decision.what_changed: Arunika staff can clock in only within 100 metres of their assigned store.
decision.why: Clock-ins from home made attendance and overtime pay wrong.
decision.alternatives: A 500 m radius was rejected because several stores sit in the same mall.

tickets.title: Driver Bumi boleh absen masuk dari mana saja dengan selfie
tickets.reason: Driver Bumi Logistik memulai kerja di jalan atau di gudang pelanggan, bukan di kantor.

decision.what_changed: Driver Bumi Logistik dikecualikan dari geofence; mereka absen masuk dari lokasi mana pun dengan foto selfie.
decision.why: Driver bekerja di lapangan sehingga radius kantor tidak masuk akal.
decision.alternatives: Absen lewat GPS truk ditolak karena tidak semua truk punya GPS.

tickets.title: Selfie liveness check on clock in
tickets.reason: Two clients reported buddy punching: one employee clocking in for another with a photo.

decision.what_changed: Clock in with a selfie now needs a liveness check: the employee blinks or turns their head on camera.
decision.why: Photos of photos let employees clock in for absent colleagues at Arunika and Bumi.

tickets.title: Clock in through the Cahaya plant turnstiles
tickets.reason: Cahaya plant staff already badge through turnstiles at the gate.

tickets.title: Split shifts for Arunika stores
tickets.reason: Arunika stores need staff for the lunch and evening peaks but not in the afternoon.

decision.what_changed: Arunika schedules may give one employee two shifts a day, with a break of at least 3 hours between them.
decision.why: Stores are busiest at lunch and in the evening.
decision.alternatives: Longer single shifts were rejected because they created overtime.

tickets.title: Tukar shift antar karyawan perlu persetujuan supervisor
tickets.reason: Karyawan saling tukar shift tanpa sepengetahuan atasan sehingga jadwal kosong.

decision.what_changed: Tukar shift antar dua karyawan harus disetujui supervisor sebelum berlaku.
decision.why: Supervisor perlu tahu siapa yang bertugas agar tidak ada shift yang kosong.

tickets.title: Night shift allowance for Bumi Logistik
tickets.reason: Bumi warehouse staff working nights were paid the allowance by hand, and some months were missed.

decision.what_changed: Each night shift (22:00–06:00) at Bumi Logistik adds a Rp 25.000 allowance to the next payslip automatically.
decision.why: Manual allowances were missed, and the union asked for it to be guaranteed.

tickets.title: Leave requests at least 3 days in advance
tickets.reason: Last-minute leave left stores and warehouses short of staff.

decision.what_changed: Annual leave must be requested at least 3 working days before it starts; sick leave is exempt.
decision.why: Supervisors need time to find cover.

tickets.title: Blackout cuti Arunika menjelang Lebaran dan akhir tahun
tickets.reason: Toko Arunika paling ramai dua minggu sebelum Lebaran dan saat sale akhir tahun.

decision.what_changed: Karyawan toko Arunika tidak bisa mengajukan cuti tahunan dua minggu sebelum Lebaran dan pada 15–31 Desember.
decision.why: Penjualan puncak butuh semua staf toko hadir.
decision.alternatives: Kuota cuti per toko ditolak karena sulit diatur untuk ratusan toko.

tickets.title: Doctor's letter for sick leave over 2 days at Cahaya
tickets.reason: Cahaya's clean-room rules require proof of health before staff return.

decision.what_changed: Cahaya Farma staff must upload a doctor's letter for sick leave longer than 2 days.
decision.why: GMP clean-room hygiene rules require a medical clearance record.

tickets.title: Unlimited unpaid leave for Bumi drivers
tickets.reason: Some drivers want long unpaid breaks between contracts.

decision.what_changed: Not implemented: unpaid leave stays capped at 30 days a year for Bumi drivers too.
decision.why: Longer unpaid leave breaks BPJS contributions and the employment status under labor law.
decision.alternatives: Contract pauses handled by HR outside the system were suggested instead.

tickets.title: Half-day leave
tickets.reason: Employees ask for half a day off for appointments.

tickets.title: Leave carry-over: at most 6 days, expiring 30 June
tickets.reason: Unused leave piled up for years and became a liability.

decision.what_changed: At year end, at most 6 unused annual leave days carry over; they expire on 30 June of the new year.
decision.why: Unlimited carry-over created large leave liabilities for clients.
decision.alternatives: Paying out unused leave was rejected because most clients' policies do not allow it.

tickets.title: Arunika carry-over 12 days
tickets.reason: Arunika's company regulation allows 12 days of carry-over.

decision.what_changed: For Arunika, up to 12 unused leave days carry over instead of the default 6; they still expire on 30 June.
decision.why: Arunika's company regulation (peraturan perusahaan) sets 12 days, and it overrides the default.

tickets.title: Saldo cuti Cahaya bertambah 1 hari per bulan
tickets.reason: Cahaya ingin karyawan baru tidak langsung mendapat 12 hari cuti.

decision.what_changed: Saldo cuti karyawan Cahaya Farma bertambah 1 hari setiap bulan, bukan 12 hari sekaligus pada 1 Januari.
decision.why: Karyawan yang resign di awal tahun sempat memakai cuti yang belum menjadi haknya.

tickets.title: Validasi NIK KTP 16 digit di profil karyawan
tickets.reason: BPJS menolak data karena NIK salah ketik.

decision.what_changed: Profil karyawan hanya menerima NIK KTP 16 digit angka, dan NIK tidak boleh dipakai dua karyawan.
decision.why: Pendaftaran BPJS gagal karena NIK salah ketik atau ganda.

tickets.title: Pharmacist licence (STRA) on Cahaya profiles
tickets.reason: BPOM inspections check that every pharmacist has a valid licence.

decision.what_changed: Cahaya employee profiles show the pharmacist licence (STRA) number and expiry, with a reminder 60 days before it expires.
decision.why: An expired licence found in a BPOM inspection can stop production.

tickets.title: Store assignment history on Arunika profiles
tickets.reason: HR needs to see which stores an employee worked at.

tickets.title: Onboarding checklist with document upload
tickets.reason: New hires' documents were collected by email and got lost.

decision.what_changed: Onboarding has a checklist where new hires upload their KTP, NPWP and BPJS card before their first day.
decision.why: Documents sent by email went missing and delayed payroll registration.

tickets.title: SIM B2 wajib untuk onboarding driver Bumi
tickets.reason: Driver truk Bumi wajib punya SIM B2 umum sesuai aturan lalu lintas.

decision.what_changed: Onboarding driver Bumi Logistik mewajibkan upload SIM B2 umum yang masih berlaku.
decision.why: Asuransi kargo menolak klaim bila driver tidak punya SIM yang sesuai.

tickets.title: Payslip PDF password is the birth date
tickets.reason: Payslips were emailed without protection.

decision.what_changed: Payslip PDFs are protected with the employee's birth date as the password, in DDMMYYYY format.
decision.why: Salary data was readable by anyone who got the email.
decision.alternatives: A separate password per employee was rejected because staff forgot it.

tickets.title: Rincian jam lembur per hari di slip gaji Arunika
tickets.reason: Staf toko Arunika sering mempertanyakan bayaran lembur.

decision.what_changed: Slip gaji Arunika menampilkan rincian jam lembur per hari beserta tarifnya.
decision.why: Karyawan bisa mencocokkan sendiri bayaran lembur sehingga keluhan ke HR berkurang.

tickets.title: Bilingual payslips for Bumi Logistik
tickets.reason: Bumi has expatriate managers who do not read Indonesian.

decision.what_changed: Bumi Logistik payslips show every label in English and Indonesian.
decision.why: Expatriate managers could not read their payslips.

tickets.title: Hide basic salary on Cahaya payslips
tickets.reason: Cahaya did not want basic salary visible to line managers who print payslips.

decision.what_changed: Not implemented: payslips keep showing basic salary.
decision.why: Regulations require every wage component on the payslip.
decision.alternatives: Restricting who can print payslips was proposed instead.

tickets.title: PPh 21 pakai tarif efektif rata-rata (TER) mulai Januari 2024
tickets.reason: PP 58/2023 mengubah cara pemotongan PPh 21 bulanan mulai 1 Januari 2024.

decision.what_changed: PPh 21 bulanan dihitung dengan tarif efektif rata-rata (TER) sesuai kategori PTKP.
decision.why: PP 58/2023 dan PMK 168/2023 mewajibkan metode TER mulai Januari 2024.

tickets.title: December PPh 21 annual true-up
tickets.reason: With TER, the monthly tax does not match the annual tax.

decision.what_changed: December PPh 21 is the full-year tax under Article 17 rates minus the tax withheld from January to November.
decision.why: PMK 168/2023 requires the annual reconciliation in the last month.

tickets.title: Gross-up PPh 21 untuk driver Bumi
tickets.reason: Bumi menanggung pajak driver sebagai bagian dari paket kerja.

decision.what_changed: PPh 21 driver Bumi Logistik dihitung dengan metode gross-up: perusahaan menanggung pajaknya sebagai tunjangan.
decision.why: Kontrak kerja driver Bumi menjanjikan gaji bersih tanpa potongan pajak.

tickets.title: BPJS Kesehatan salary cap Rp 12 million
tickets.reason: Contributions were computed on full salaries above the legal cap.

decision.what_changed: BPJS Kesehatan contributions use the salary up to Rp 12,000,000 as their base.
decision.why: Perpres 64/2020 sets the cap; above it employees were overcharged.

tickets.title: BPJS untuk pegawai part-time Arunika sejak bulan pertama
tickets.reason: Arunika ingin pegawai part-time toko terlindungi sejak awal.

decision.what_changed: Arunika mendaftarkan dan membayar BPJS Ketenagakerjaan untuk pegawai part-time sejak bulan pertama, tidak menunggu masa percobaan.
decision.why: Kecelakaan kerja pegawai baru di toko tidak tertanggung saat masa percobaan.

tickets.title: Prorated THR under 12 months of service
tickets.reason: THR for new employees was calculated by hand each year.

decision.what_changed: THR for employees with 1 to 12 months of service is months worked ÷ 12 × monthly wage, paid at least 7 days before Lebaran.
decision.why: Permenaker 6/2016 sets the proration and the deadline.

tickets.title: THR pekerja harian Arunika dari rata-rata upah 12 bulan
tickets.reason: Pekerja harian Arunika upahnya berubah tiap bulan.

decision.what_changed: THR pekerja harian Arunika dihitung dari rata-rata upah 12 bulan terakhir.
decision.why: Permenaker 6/2016 mengatur THR pekerja harian berdasarkan rata-rata upah.

tickets.title: THR in two installments for Cahaya
tickets.reason: Cahaya wanted to spread the THR cash outflow.

decision.what_changed: Not implemented: THR is paid in full, once, at least 7 days before Lebaran.
decision.why: Permenaker 6/2016 does not allow installments; late or partial THR is fined.
decision.alternatives: Paying the full THR earlier from a reserve was suggested.

tickets.title: Bank transfer file in KlikBCA Bisnis format
tickets.reason: Finance retyped salaries into the bank's portal.

decision.what_changed: Payroll exports the salary transfer as a KlikBCA Bisnis bulk transfer CSV.
decision.why: Retyping hundreds of salaries caused transfer errors.

tickets.title: Gaji karyawan Bumi dibagi ke dua rekening
tickets.reason: Banyak driver Bumi ingin sebagian gaji langsung ke rekening keluarga.

decision.what_changed: Karyawan Bumi Logistik dapat membagi gaji ke dua rekening (Mandiri dan BRI) dengan persentase tetap.
decision.why: Driver jarang pulang dan keluarga butuh uang belanja tepat waktu.

tickets.title: Transfer file for Bank Syariah Indonesia at Cahaya
tickets.reason: Cahaya moved its payroll account to BSI.

tickets.title: Arunika attendance report grouped by store
tickets.reason: Area managers compare stores every week.

decision.what_changed: The Arunika attendance report groups employees by store and exports to Excel.
decision.why: Area managers review attendance per store each Monday.

tickets.title: Toleransi terlambat 10 menit di laporan keterlambatan
tickets.reason: Karyawan yang terlambat 1–2 menit ikut dihitung terlambat.

decision.what_changed: Laporan keterlambatan memberi toleransi 10 menit; baru dihitung terlambat setelah 10 menit dari jam masuk.
decision.why: Terlambat beberapa menit karena antre absen tidak adil dihitung sebagai pelanggaran.

tickets.title: Cahaya headcount by plant and department
tickets.reason: BPOM audits ask for monthly headcount per plant.

decision.what_changed: Cahaya Farma gets a monthly headcount report by plant and department.
decision.why: BPOM auditors ask for staffing levels per production plant.

tickets.title: Turnover rate on the headcount report
tickets.reason: Clients want turnover rates.

tickets.title: Notifikasi approval lembur terkirim dua kali ke HR Arunika
tickets.reason: HR Arunika menerima dua notifikasi untuk setiap pengajuan lembur.

decision.what_changed: Notifikasi approval lembur kini hanya dikirim sekali; pengiriman ganda dari retry sudah diperbaiki.
decision.why: Notifikasi ganda membuat HR menyetujui pengajuan dua kali.

tickets.title: Negative leave balance after carry-over expired
tickets.reason: After 30 June, some balances showed minus days.

decision.what_changed: Expiring carried-over leave no longer takes the balance below zero; leave already taken from carry-over is kept.
decision.why: Employees who used carried-over days before 30 June saw negative balances.
